customer_decision_state: The customer broadly understands the category, but imagined sensory experience, ritual, atmosphere or lifestyle fit materially determines desire and choice.
first_persuasive_job: Make the desired sensory/experiential state imaginable before dense explanation, then hand off to bounded evidence before meaningful commitment.
fit_boundary: BW-F01 is selected because sensory expectation changes the decision, not because the brand uses beige, green, natural textures or calm photography. Production Feasibility cannot select the Family.

reference_companies.decision_state: Customer broadly understands cosmetics but chooses a worldview/ritual as much as functional efficacy.
reference_companies.within_family_distinctiveness: Can braid ritual/product/multi-sense narrative with scientific support; proof handoff is later and more product-contextual.

reference_companies.decision_state: Customer seeks a calming sensory identity and lifestyle fit, not diagnosis-led choice.
reference_companies.within_family_distinctiveness: A slower tree/material/environment narrative with sustainability support should differ structurally from THREE.

compatible_module_grammar.role: recognition/desire-led first view without premature proof wall
scene-based tension naming grounded in a real use moment
atmosphere as a decision scene, not decoration
state-specific next event after enough desire/trust

conditional_support_grammar.condition: only as a secondary proof handoff when mechanism/process actually matters and is evidenced; never let it convert the opening into F06

prohibited_or_misfit_grammar: generic beige/green/natural styling presented as evidence of F01
dense clinical/evidence-first hero unless the actual first job has shifted to F02/F06
F04 provenance/maker story dominating when human/material origin is actually the gating trust mechanism
abstract wellness copy with no concrete ritual/use/context handoff
decorative gallery sequence with no decision role

art_direction_contract.hero: Create an authored sensory first view through environment, material, ritual or state change; do not reuse Nagi's category-education/routing silhouette merely because both can be calm.
art_direction_contract.media: Large environmental/material/ritual media may carry meaning. Crops must preserve tactile or situational cues; stock-like mood imagery without a decision role is insufficient.
art_direction_contract.typography: Quiet display authority, generous leading and deliberate scale are allowed, but typography must support the sensory thesis rather than imitate a luxury/wellness template.
art_direction_contract.density: Low density early with purposeful breathing room; evidence density should rise at the exact point a customer needs confidence before commitment.
art_direction_contract.cta: Use a bounded next event appropriate to the reference company—experience, explore, trial, store/service detail—rather than an always-on hard conversion.
art_direction_contract.responsive: Preserve visual breathing room and sensory crop logic on 320–430px; do not collapse authored atmosphere into a generic text-image stack. Apply optical line-break checks at every required width.

collision_rules.discriminator: F01 when imagined experience/atmosphere itself carries desire; F04 when maker, human technique, provenance or how-it-is-made evidence is indispensable to trust and meaning.
collision_rules.human_review_trigger: sensory experience and provenance are equally central and neither can be subordinated

collision_rules.discriminator: F01 when sensory state/lifestyle fit leads; F03 when aspirational/premium authority and authored status lead into rational commitment.
collision_rules.human_review_trigger: premium authority and sensory worldview are inseparable in the verified decision state

anti_template_requirements: THREE and BAUM must differ in hero framing, narrative pacing, proof handoff and ending despite sharing sensory logic.
Compared with Nagi F08, F01 must not use category education or three-route service topology as its center of gravity.
Compared with uka F04, atmosphere must not merely wrap a craft/provenance sequence; sensory desire itself must carry the first persuasive job.
Shared M-HERO-01 compatibility with F07/F08 is not permission for a shared hero layout.
Color/photo/logo/copy substitution alone is a template-swap failure.

production_feasibility_separate_profile.allowed_effect: After Family freeze, may choose safe generated/stock/material/environment media and adjust gallery realization without inventing sensory claims or switching Family because ideal assets are unavailable.
